_notes.asSystemSites: raised 90 to 91 (files 44 to 45, reasons 27 to 28) in A5 step 6c: an approved pending call leaves the scope of the path that approves it (a request's, an MCP connection's) only to enter the scope it was asked in, met with its asker's rights now (packages/tools/src/pending-origin.ts withOriginScope, reason 'pending-approval'). It reads nothing on the system pool on the way; before it, the call ran in the approving path's scope or in none. It is ROUTE_POLICY's own check of the rows, as FRAME_ROWS is, not a policy beside them.
